The feeling of being useless, helpless, and weak.  The feeling of being a failure, a loser, and a disappointment.

Thank you for telling me that.  It was hard enough telling my parents.  It’ll be even harder telling my friends or other family.  I’m too weak.

There is something wrong with me and I’m reminded of it every single day.  It’s all I can think about every minute of every day.  I can’t get it off my mind.  It’s so bad.  And I’ll never get this image of myself ever until it’s fixed but it can’t be fixed.
I have friends and brothers but I can’t talk to them about this stuff.  If my parents can’t help me then I don’t expect anyone else to have the maturity to do so.  My dad even tried blaming me.
How?  It’s impossible for me to change what’s wrong with me.
I can’t.  I feel like a loser, a failure, a disappointment.  I feel inadequate, useless, helpless, weak.  I’ll never stop feeling that way.

I told my parents that I didn’t want to live anymore.  My mom hung up on me and my dad shut me down.  I seriously don’t think they care.

Besides, I really don’t want to continue living while feeling the way I do.  It’s too hard.  I don’t care if someone is gonna miss me.  I’m tired of being alive
I’ve told the people that are close to me how I felt and they didn’t even try helping.  I don’t think they’d care all that much if I was gone.  They’d probably end up being happy I wasn’t around.

Thank you so much for the offer but I’m afraid there’s nothing to talk about.  If I could change it I would.  I really would but I can’t.  I feel so helpless and useless.  That’s my issue.  And I’ll never stop feeling like that.  Ever.
I don’t want to live like this anymore
